title: C++ Fundamentals and I/O Streams
description: Structure of a C++ program, preprocessor directives, iostream, std::cin, and std::cout.

title: Primitive Types, Variables and Constants
description: Standard data types, sizeof operator, const qualifiers, and auto type deduction.

title: Arithmetic, Relational and Bitwise Operators
description: Arithmetic precedence, bitwise masking, shift operators, and ternary expressions.

title: If-Else and Switch Control
description: Branching with if-else, nested conditionals, and switch-case statements.

title: While, Do-While and For Loops
description: Repetition constructs: for loop, range-based for, while, and do-while loops.

title: Functions, Pass by Value and Reference
description: Function declaration vs definition, default arguments, inline functions, and parameter passing.

title: Arrays and C-Style Strings / std::string
description: Fixed-size arrays, null-terminated char arrays, and the modern std::string class.

title: Pointer Fundamentals and Pointer Arithmetic
description: Address-of operator (&), dereference operator (*), pointer arithmetic, and nullptr.

title: References and Memory Addresses
description: Lvalue references, aliasing, const references, and comparison with pointers.

title: Dynamic Allocation with new and delete
description: Heap allocation using new and new[], deallocation with delete and delete[], and memory leaks.

title: Classes, Constructors and Destructors
description: Encapsulation, public/private access, constructor initializer lists, and RAII destructors.

title: Operator Overloading and Friend Functions
description: Customizing operator semantics (+, -, <<, ==) and friend classes/functions.

title: Single, Multiple and Virtual Inheritance
description: Public/private inheritance, multiple base classes, and solving diamond inheritance with virtual base classes.

title: Virtual Functions and Abstract Classes
description: Runtime polymorphism with virtual functions, vtable mechanics, and pure virtual functions (= 0).

title: Vectors, Lists, Maps and Iterators
description: Standard Template Library: std::vector, std::list, std::map, std::unordered_map, and iterators.

title: Templates and Exception Handling
description: Generic programming with function and class templates, try/catch/throw, and smart pointers.
